decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith (Application Form and Letter, 4303- 09, 10, 11, 15A, 16, 17, 18A, 19, 20A, 21A, 22, and 24 received 20/05/11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A statement of protection and construction methodologies necessary to preserve the adjacent listed building during demolition and construction works to be submitted, to include a photographic record of the buildings before scaffolding and any demolitions.
Condition : 4 - Details of the junction between the retained and new areas of building to be provided
Condition : 5 - A sample panel indicating bricks, mortar and joint profile to be constructed on site and approved before construction.
Condition : 6 - Details of the fascias and verge construction to be submitted
Condition : 7 - The suggested tinting finish is to be tested on a sample area, following construction, and approved before carrying out on the actual building.
description: Extension of time period to implement planning permission 00249/A/P53 dated 09/10/2008 for the erection of an extension to increase the height of the walls and roof incorporating internal changes to the Old Chapel Tun Room to allow for the installation of Maturation Tanks.
